label: Today You Will Learn
h: How to name a prediction as a prediction, and separate what is possible, what is probable, and what is actually happening now.
body:
About 8 minutes, plus one short pause · one small practice · no homework list

If there is evidence of real danger, abuse, coercion or a medical emergency, do not use this lesson to talk yourself out of it. Move to safety and get help.

label: Key Scripture
h: "Do not be anxious about tomorrow, for tomorrow will be anxious for itself. Sufficient for the day is its own trouble."

label: Meet Esther
body:
4:30 pm"Could you come and see me at eight tomorrow?"
5:00 pmI am being dismissed.
6:00 pmA parent must have complained.
8:00 pmHow long will my savings last?
8:00 am"Would you take an extra class?" Six minutes.

label: Name The Pattern · Catastrophising
body:
A trigger→The worst interpretation, in seconds→A chain, each link built on the last→Real distress in the body

It is convincing because every link is possible.

label: The Main Truth
body:
PossibleCould it happen? Almost anything could.
ProbableDoes what I actually know point that way?
PresentWhat is true right now, and nothing more?

Dread collapses these three into one. The way out is to separate them again.

label: The Tool · Four Questions, In Order
body:
1. What am I predicting?
  2. What do I actually know that supports or challenges it?
  3. What is actually happening right now?
  4. What does the present require of me?

label: A Common Defence
h: "If I imagine the worst, at least I will be ready for it."
body: Real preparation is specific, bounded, and gets finished. If you have "prepared" for the same disaster forty times, you have not been preparing. You have been suffering.

label: Back To Esther
h:
Test the first link only.
If it does not hold, the rest of the chain has nothing to hang from.

label: Do This Now
h: Choose one thing you have been forecasting. Write two lines.
body:
What is actually true right now?  ·  What does today require of me?

Pause the audio

label: Remember
h: My mind can imagine many tomorrows. I have been given only today.

label: Prayer
body:
Father, you know the tomorrows
I have been living in advance.

Here is what is true today.

Give me what today requires,
and let tomorrow stay in your hands.

Amen.
